newsitem.title: UK: Thorn says plans to close 90 stores.
newsitem.headline: Thorn says plans to close 90 stores.

text.p: British electronic rental and retail group Thorn Plc said on Monday it planned to close around 90 Radio Rentals stores.
The company said the stores represented around 15 percent of all Radio Rentals outlets at the end of last year but generated seven percent of total new business over the nine-month period.
Thorn said also it would shed around 360 jobs as part of a rationalisation of central support functions in Britain. The associated one-off costs would be charged against existing provisions.
